headline: Reserve Bank of India Accepts ₹7,627 Crore in 2-Day VRRR Auction
summary: The Reserve Bank of India accepted ₹7,627 crore of offers in its two-day variable rate reverse repo auction out of ₹50,000 crore notified, at a cut-off rate of 5.49%.
why: The Reserve Bank of India conducts reverse repo auctions to manage short-term liquidity in the banking system and guide money market interest rates.
